A FEW LITTLE ANSWERS

Wondering
about something?

Here’s the short version.

Is Momentra free?

The app is free and open source. You provide your own AI key or local model. AI services set their own prices, free-model availability and limits; Momentra doesn’t include API credit.

Do I need to install Python myself?

No. Extract the ZIP and double-click Start Momentra.cmd. The launcher downloads a private Python environment and the video tools on first start. The ZIP contains no EXE files, but the downloaded runtime and tools are executable programs. Internet and at least 3 GB free are needed, plus room for your videos.

Can it find normal moments, not just big highlights?

Yes. Everyday moments accepts complete, watchable spoken moments without requiring a big reaction. Strict highlights is also available. AI selection can miss things, so Clip last 30s and Last 60s let you save a moment yourself.

What happens if my AI key stops working?

Save backup keys and services, then enable automatic failover. Your primary profile stays saved, and services’ rate-limit waits still apply. You can also refresh an AI check while recording continues. Without usable AI, local loudness-based clipping remains available.

Can I combine two live chats?

You can record one video feed and combine up to two linked public Twitch, Kick or YouTube chats for the same creator. Status, read-only message previews and timing offsets are included. Platform availability can vary; chat choices apply to the next recording.

Can it publish automatically?

Yes, after you connect eligible accounts and explicitly configure your creator’s posting settings. Instagram requires Meta setup and a reachable HTTPS link; its free temporary tunnel address changes after restart. Export checks and platform permissions still apply. Keep Momentra, your computer and the network running for scheduled posts.

Does closing the browser stop a recording?

No. The local engine keeps running in its console. Keep that console open, and keep the computer awake. Press Ctrl+C in the console when you want to stop Momentra.
